items.t: ABS module can short and cause an engine bay fire (recall)
items.note: Recall 23V-652 covers this. The recall fix is often just a new fuse. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Airbags may not deploy in a crash (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 18V-363. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.
Free under recall 13V-114. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.job: Replace transmission cooler hose and top off fluid
items.note: Free under recall 16V-070. Damage from running low on fluid costs much more.

items.t: Theft risk on key-start models without immobilizer
items.note: Free at Kia dealers; some cars get an ignition guard instead. Fixing a damaged ignition costs extra.

items.t: Brake lights stay on and shifter leaves Park without brake (recall)
items.job: Replace brake pedal stopper pad and switch
items.note: Free under recall 17V-773. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Engine damage and engine bay fire (recall)
items.note: Recall 20V-750 and Kia's extended engine warranty may cover this. Keep oil-change records and check the VIN.

items.t: Cooling fan resistor can overheat and melt (recall)
items.job: Replace cooling fan resistor and connector
items.note: Free under recall 15V-015. If the fan motor was damaged, it may need replacing too.

items.t: Trunk cannot be opened from inside (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-622. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Oil pump can fail from debris (recall)
items.job: Replace oil pump and change oil
items.note: Free under recall 21V-260. If low oil pressure damaged the engine, replacement costs much more.
Free under recall 22V-031. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Left front axle shaft may break (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-459. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not switch off for a child seat (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger seat occupant sensor unit
items.note: Free under recall 21V-164. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Front lower control arm weld defect (do-not-drive recall)
items.note: Free under recalls 23V-649 and 24V-244. Alignment recommended after.
Free under recall 22V-906. Alignment needed after.
